text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I guess some Umamusume are just more
gifted
than others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Having natural talent and charm—that's
just how
they're born. And it turns their
whole life into a
spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Those are the racers who become the
stuff of
legends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No one can surpass you if you become a
legend...
But still!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run as if this weren't Oguri's
last race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If I keep thinking about it like some big thing, I'll lose... And then the one everyone is rooting to win will win, simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly.
I'm in the right position to catch up to
Oguri, and I'll get my second
Grand Prix crown
fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think wrapping things up like that
would give
everyone the most to hope
for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even a legend can be surpassed with the
right
effort. And there's no better time
and place to
prove it than now!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll run like I always do. My moves will
depend on
what happens on the track.
I'm staking it all on
instinct...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is I who will succeed Oguri—in order
to usher in
a new era belonging to the
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I believe in the strength of this body
that my
trainer and I have been working
so hard on
sculpting together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the senior year Arima Kinen. The
culmination
of all Mejiro Ryan's hard
work is about to begin!
